caption:
Smart business owners don't just claim more. They time it.

3 moves before 30 June:

1. Prepay. A small business (turnover under $10M) can claim a prepaid expense straight away if it covers 12 months or less and the period ends by the end of next income year. Think rent, insurance, subscriptions.

2. Buy before 30 June. The $20,000 instant asset write-off only counts once the asset is used or installed ready for use. Still in the box doesn't count.

3. Top up super. The concessional cap is $32,500 for 2026–27, and a contribution counts in the year your fund receives it.

The catch: all three cost cash now. They suit a business that was going to spend the money anyway.

Which one will you use? Tell us in the comments.
